{{Quote|The weapons run from Minoth to Hendrix is off. That's not a big deal. I'll just bring the guns here instead.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="HAT">''[[Honor Among Thieves]]''</ref>}}
'''Hendrix''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Iska sector/Legends|Iska sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] planned to run weapons from [[Minoth/Legends|Minoth]] to Hendrix for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="HAT" />
